<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(f):
    s={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['pixels']<=5 and b and 43<=b[0][0]<=47:
            s[b[0][1]]=1 if n['color']=='B' else 0
    return tuple(s[c] for c in (21,26,31,36,41))
def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(('b',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(out)
base_objs=objs(current_frame)
def check(tag):
    r=last_action_result
    moved = objs(current_frame)!=base_objs
    done = r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('done')
    print(tag, "bars:", barstate(current_frame), "moved:", moved, "done:", done)
    return done or moved
cols=[21,26,31,36,41]
stop=False
for c in cols:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':c}])
    if check("seq15 %d"%c): stop=True; break
if not stop:
    for c in reversed(cols):
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':c}])
        if check("seq51 %d"%c): stop=True; break
print("stop:", stop)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
